items.title: Meta's Muse AI Agent Comes to Apple Watch
items.excerpt: Meta updated the Muse iOS app with Apple Watch support, so users can text, dictate to or call the proactive Muse AI agent from the wrist, with a watch-face complication for quick access.

items.title: Siri Is Getting a Better Memory
items.excerpt: Code in the iOS 27.3 beta reveals a personal 'memory graph' for Siri that organizes relationships, places, habits and important events so the assistant can retain context about a user's life.

items.title: Apple's $50 Intelligence Usage Packs extend access to some AI features
items.excerpt: Instead of a subscription, Apple is selling $50 packs of extra usage credits for some Apple Intelligence features in its Creator Studio apps once the included allotment runs out.

items.title: Exclusive: Here's what Samsung's Galaxy AI Premium plan brings and what remains free
items.excerpt: SamMobile lists which Galaxy AI features would move behind a reported $4.99/month Galaxy AI Premium plan and which stay free on Galaxy phones.

items.title: Samsung is working on a new Galaxy AI app to clean up the screenshot mess you've been pretending doesn't exist
items.excerpt: Samsung is developing Memory, a Galaxy AI app that saves screenshots, links, text and voice notes and automatically organizes them into searchable collections, similar to Pixel Screenshots.

items.title: One UI 9.5 may bring AI agent capabilities to Bixby on your Galaxy phone
items.excerpt: Code in One UI 9.5 suggests Samsung may give Bixby AI agent capabilities on Galaxy phones; the stock Voice Recorder app could also pick up new features.

items.title: Digital Wellbeing v1.50 beta gives us our first look at Weekly Insights and Gemini integration
items.excerpt: An APK teardown of Google's Digital Wellbeing beta shows AI-generated Weekly Insights powered by Gemini, and suggests the feature may not be limited to Gemini Nano devices.

items.title: Leak: HONOR Robot Phone 2 is in the works, could launch next year
items.excerpt: Honor is reportedly developing a second-generation Robot Phone, its AI-focused handset, for a possible launch next year, even as buyers still struggle to get the first model.

items.title: Wearable sleep trackers are using your brainwaves to train AI models without explicit user consent
items.excerpt: Wearable neurotech companies have collected tens of millions of hours of EEG recordings from sleep headbands to train AI models, raising questions about consent and who controls neural data.

items.title: 편의점 직원 된 휴머노이드 로봇…24시간 근무 도전
items.excerpt: 중국 애지봇이 상하이 편의점에 바퀴형 휴머노이드 'G2' 6대를 투입해 24시간 근무를 시험했다. 로봇들은 손님 응대·진열·커피 제조·청소 등 1730건의 작업을 처리했다.

items.title: AI 안경 쓰고 시험 치다 적발된 중·고생 4명…전원 0점 처리
items.excerpt: 교육부 전수조사 결과 2026학년도 중·고교 내신 시험에서 AI 스마트 안경을 이용한 부정행위 4건이 확인돼 전원 0점 처리됐다. 수능을 앞두고 AI 안경 단속이 강화되고 있다.

items.title: Christian Linux project plans $449 phone with AI-powered Bible study
items.excerpt: Jesus Dash combines a Linux OS, an AI assistant and religious resources; its founder is also building a $449 smartphone called PineCone targeted for early 2027.

items.title: This prototype camera is fighting the good fight against AI photography
items.excerpt: The CAIM-1 prototype camera embeds cryptographic proof of origin into every photo at the sensor level, a hardware answer to AI-generated fakes.

items.title: Don't like Google Health's AI Coach? Here's how to turn it off
items.excerpt: Engadget walks through disabling the Gemini-powered Google Health Coach on Fitbit and Pixel Watch setups without dropping Premium, and notes LLM-generated reports still appear across the app.

items.title: AI teddy bears spark fresh 'Funzo' fears — as new report discovers malfunctioning toy that tells children 'I can't help with killing you'
items.excerpt: A BBC investigation found an AI teddy marketed for three-year-olds making unprompted remarks about killing and suicide, as AI toys head into the holiday season.

items.title: Windows 11 users will get the choice to integrate Copilot AI in the search box as an optional extra
items.excerpt: Microsoft plans an opt-in option to integrate the new Copilot into the Windows 11 taskbar search box for inline answers, rolling out first to select markets later this year.

items.title: AI can read the radiation coming from an HDMI cable to mimic the video being passed over it
items.excerpt: Researchers used a new AI model to reconstruct on-screen video from electromagnetic leakage of ordinary HDMI cables, improving text accuracy by over 60%.

items.title: Text, shop, done: Alexa for Shopping is now just a text away
items.excerpt: Amazon now lets a subset of customers text its Alexa for Shopping AI agent to get shopping done, with the texting option rolling out across the U.S. in the coming weeks.

items.title: Google brings Gemini to AT&T home security with smarter alerts and 24/7 recording
items.excerpt: Gemini for Home is coming to AT&T Connected Life, adding smarter camera alerts, automatic arming, 24/7 recording and searchable video to the home security service.
